comment_text.value:
Location: Honolulu, HI (HST)

Remote: Yes (US)

Willing to relocate: Yes, at my own expense

Technologies: Node.js, Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase (Postgres + pgvector), Claude API / RAG / LLM integration, PHP/WordPress, Shopify, AWS, Cloudflare

Résumé/CV: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nejc-anisco/

Email: hello@nateeatshawaii.com

Self-taught full-stack dev, 9 years freelance. Over the past 10 months I've built and run https://nateeatshawaii.com solo — a bilingual (EN/JA) restaurant guide on Next.js/Supabase doing 17k+ visitors/mo with page-one Google rankings. The Japanese side is produced by a Claude API pipeline I just open-sourced (https://github.com/HiNateK/nateeats-content-pipeline) — translation with a domain-tuned prompt plus a one-command publish script (OpenCV face-blur for privacy, watermarking, sitemap/index wiring). JP content drives ~1/3 of traffic. Also rebuilt the site's 1,900-listing map from a client-side SPA to server-rendered ISR to kill OOM builds.

Just shipped "Ask the guide" — RAG chat over the 1,900 listings (Voyage embeddings, pgvector in Supabase, Claude API answers grounded in retrieved listings). Live on the homepage — try it.

Before that: WordPress/WooCommerce plugin work (Stripe subscriptions), Shopify builds, and incident response on a compromised production WordPress site (CVE-2024-25600 class — remediated in under 48h, wrote the breach report).

Looking for: full-stack or AI-integration roles at small teams; founding engineer conversations welcome. US work authorized, no sponsorship needed.
